Arrows: a bold dark-blue curved arrow arcs over the top line from the first tick (100 cm) to the second tick (blank cm), with the bold label '×2' on it; a second bold dark-blue curved arrow on the far left runs from the bottom line's first tick (1 m) UP to the top line's first tick (100 cm), with the bold label '×100' beside it.
